summary: Read materialized SCTA ST I q19 a3–5,7–8,10 and pinned Elwes Spinoza Ethics I definitions/axioms,16–17,29–33. Aquinas explicitly proposes self-determination of necessary will toward nonnecessary secondary objects (a3 ad5–6), distinguishes a cause of the single act from rational ordering of its objects (a5), and rejects secondary-cause defect as sufficient contingency explanation (a8). Spinoza I33 note II grants will as essence for an internal objection: different complete decrees imply different actual intellect/will and hence essence. His freedom means action from own nature (definition 7), not contingent choice. Rejected self-sufficiency-alone as proof of contingent willing, no-cause as no-object-reasons, temporal immutability as cross-world identity, and varying world-label tables as explanatory free creation. Detailed exact locators, strongest replies, rejected readings and remaining gaps persist in docs/notes/selected-effect-bridge-462.md, source follow-up. No new result, premise establishment or root-premise change. Follow-up bounded source-entitlement audit (2026-11-01): materialized and read LEIBNIZ-MONADOLOGY-31-45 in full, focusing on §§33,36–38, and complete AQUINAS-ST-I-Q19-A3 and AQUINAS-ST-I-Q19-A8. Reproducible texts are .cache/truth-core/sources/LEIBNIZ-MONADOLOGY-31-45.txt and AQUINAS-ST-I-Q19-A3.txt / AQUINAS-ST-I-Q19-A8.txt. Existing LEIBNIZ-SERIES-SUFFICIENT-REASON-A records §§32,36–38: a necessary substance as final reason does not itself establish necessity of every complete explanatory specification or transfer necessity to all contingent effects. Aquinas q19a3 corpus/ad4–6 distinguishes necessary willing in itself from a nonnecessary relation to particular objects, arguing that complete divine goodness does not require creatures. This is a substantive qualification to identifying necessary bearer/act with a necessarily obtaining complete specification of this effect. The argument from means dispensable to the end does not independently exclude every other proposed determinant of the complete choice. Q19a8 corpus/ad1–3 rejects explaining contingency solely by secondary-cause defects: the effect’s contingent mode must itself be intended; merely adding a contingent secondary enabler is therefore not automatically a faithful sufficient account. Existing JointCondition.contingent and necessityEquivalence preserve the owner’s fixed-joint-condition observation: an obtaining fixed collection containing a contingent exercise/intention/enabler fact is contingent, without making its necessary bearer contingent or reifying the collection as an individual. Whether that contingent specification is intrinsic, relational, independently determined or otherwise adequately explained remains unresolved. Exact remaining discriminator: can a complete rational intentional specification of this effect vary without an additional contingent intrinsic item, independent external determinant, or necessitation by the necessary act? Existing generic nonnecessitating controls and the prior source audit already expose this fork; no additional model, formal proof, source claim, automatic source-to-analyst-head binding, premise truth or discharge is produced. In particular, these passages do not independently supply AutonomousFactsNecessaryAt or WholeGroundNecessitatesTargetAt.
blocker: Independently defend or refute whether a complete rational intentional specification can vary without an additional contingent intrinsic item, independent external determinant, or necessitation by the necessary act. This is an unproved proposed research fork, not certified coverage; intrinsic identity and intentional relations remain unmodeled.
